summary: Iter16 backend testing complete: cash_movements + fixed_assets CRUD + balance.detail integration in /api/reports. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter16_accounting.py with 31 tests covering validation, RBAC, audit-log integration, derived depreciation math, balance-sheet identity (Assets = Liabilities + Equity), modal/utang aggregation from cash movements, and regression smoke on iter5-iter14 endpoints. All 31/31 PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 939 lines - approaching the >700 lines threshold; consider modularization by feature (accounting, reports, sales, purchases) for maintainability.

_asset_derived is called for every asset on every /api/reports request (N+1-like pattern for read path). For MVP volumes this is fine, but consider caching derived values or computing in one pass if asset count grows.

kas formula uses max(kas, 0) in total_aset_lancar (line 818) which hides negative operational cash; this could mask real cash overdrafts in the balance sheet. Consider showing actual (possibly negative) kas value in Aset Lancar total, or splitting negative kas into liability side.

laba_ditahan is derived as plug (total_assets - liabilities - modal_disetor), which forces balance-sheet identity but hides real retained earnings drift. Acceptable for MVP but should later be computed from cumulative net income.

CashMovementInput/AssetInput use plain str fields for date without Pydantic validators - validation is done manually inside endpoint; consider Pydantic field_validator for cleaner errors and auto 422 semantics.
